items.title: Show HN: Wtdb – give every Git worktree its own database
items.summary: 针对多个 Git worktree 并行开发时共用同一本地 Postgres 数据库导致 schema 冲突的问题，开发者创建了 Wtdb 工具，为每个 Git worktree 自动分配独立的数据库实例，从而避免分支间 migration 互相干扰。该工具解决了 agentic coding 场景下多分支并发操作数据库时的 schema 竞争问题。
items.why_now: 刚发布解决AI并行编码中数据库冲突的Wtdb新工具
items.summary_en: The tool **Wtdb** lets each Git worktree automatically run its own isolated local PostgreSQL database, so parallel agentic coding sessions no longer collide when one branch runs a migration. It eliminates cross-branch schema conflicts and removes the need to manually manage which branch "owns" the shared database, targeting developers running multiple concurrent Git worktree workflows.

items.title: Spam Detection for Inbound Agent Mail
items.summary: Nylas 为 AI Agent 邮箱（Agent Accounts，目前处于 Beta 阶段）提供了策略级垃圾邮件过滤机制，通过 `use_list_dnsbl` 检查发件服务器是否在 DNS 黑名单中，以及 `use_header_anomaly_detection` 检测邮件标头的结构异常，两项均在 SMTP 层于模型处理前生效。被标记的邮件将自动路由至 Junk 文件夹而非收件箱，Agent 的正常读取路径不会触达，且垃圾邮件保留期须短于收件箱保留期，适合处理短周期工作流的 Agent。对于已知恶意域名（如 spam-domain.com），可通过创建规则（Rules）结合 block 动作在 SMTP 层直接拒收，或使用 mark_as_spam 动作将灰度发送者（如通知洪流）确定性导向 Junk 文件夹，规则按优先级 0-1000 从低到高顺序匹配。
items.why_now: Nylas 刚推出专为 AI Agent 设计的托管邮箱（beta），并开放了过滤垃圾邮件的 API
items.summary_en: Nylas Agent Accounts (beta) support policy-level spam filtering that runs before an AI agent ever sees inbound mail, using two signals: DNS blocklist lookups (`use_list_dnsbl`) and header anomaly detection (`use_header_anomaly_detection`), with configurable `spam_sensitivity`. Flagged messages route to the system junk folder (not inbox), and retention periods for spam must be shorter than inbox retention. For deterministic control, rules can `block` known-bad senders at the SMTP layer or `mark_as_spam` for gray-area senders, with rules evaluated in priority order (0–1000, lower first) and matching on sender fields like `from.domain`.

items.title: I wasted $43 rebuilding a Vectorize index the wrong way — here's the $5.50 fix
items.summary: 一次 Vectorize 原地重建索引时，因检索分数从 0.78 降至 0.61，导致 Claude RAG fallback 2,880 次，产生 43 美元费用。改用 Blue/Green 部署方案后，仅增加 1.20 美元并行存储成本与少量索引重建费用，实际总成本降至 5.50 美元，且新旧索引切换仅中断 4.19 秒。该经验表明，向量分块长度从 512 缩减至 256 可显著提升短文档的检索准确率，且批量 upsert 请求控制在 500 以内可避免超时。
items.why_now: 刚发现原地重建 Vectorize 索引导致 6 小时隐性降质，触发 2880 次 Claude fallback 浪费 $43，蓝绿部署成本仅 $5.50
items.summary_en: An in-place rebuild of a 180K-vector Vectorize index silently degraded RAG recall as 512-token chunks were too coarse, causing 2,880 Claude Sonnet fallbacks at ~5K input tokens each, costing $43 out of a $312 Anthropic bill. A Blue/Green swap—creating ads-insights-v2 with 256-token chunks, validating against a 20-query golden set, and flipping via one `wrangler deploy` env var—reduced cost to $5.50 ($1.20 extra storage over one day) and achieved just 4.19 seconds of downtime. Key rebuild tactics: 500 vectors per upsert batch (below 1,000 doc limit to avoid timeouts) with retry logic. Full step-by-step including golden-set validation is on riversealab.com.

items.title: Your AI agent has amnesia. Here's the file architecture I use to fix it.
items.summary: 该文章提出了一套基于纯 Markdown 文件的 AI Agent 记忆架构，解决 Agent 无身份认同和跨会话遗忘两大问题：第一层由 SOUL.md、IDENTITY.md、USER.md、AGENTS.md 四个静态文件构成 Agent 的身份与行为准则；第二层采用三层记忆模型——按日追加的原始日志（memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md）、定期提炼的长期记忆（MEMORY.md）、按需检索的召回机制，形成"原始记录→策展提炼→按需提取"的流转链路。作者强调以文件而非向量数据库存储，因其可读、可 diff、可 git 版本管理，并打包为 AI Soul Kit（Core ¥980 / Plus ¥3,800）可直接复用。
items.why_now: **实用多智能体记忆架构方案，可包抄 RAG 记忆和向量数据库方案。**
items.summary_en: A lightweight file-based memory architecture uses two layers to fix agent amnesia: static identity files (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md) as the persistent constitution, and a 3-tier memory system (daily raw notes in `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` → curated `MEMORY.md` → on-demand recall via search) that handles continuity across sessions. Plain Markdown replaces a vector DB for single-agent use, prioritizing grep-ability, git version-control, and portability over embeddings. The core rule: durable knowledge must be written to file immediately or it is lost on session restart.

items.title: andrewyng/aisuite
items.summary: **aisuite** 是一个轻量级 Python 库，提供统一的 Chat Completions API，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Mistral、Hugging Face、AWS、Cohere、Ollama、OpenRouter 等多个大模型提供商，开发者只需更改一个字符串即可切换底层模型。在此基础上，aisuite 还提供 Agents API，支持将 Python 函数直接作为工具调用，并兼容 MCP 协议和预置工具包（文件、Git、Shell 等）。基于 aisuite 构建的桌面 AI 应用 **OpenCoworker** 已发布 macOS（Apple Silicon）和 Windows 10/11 版本，可读取文件、收发消息（Slack、邮件等）、生成 PDF/文档/电子表格，并支持定时自动化任务（如每日新闻摘要），用户需自备 API Key 或通过 Ollama 本地运行，数据完全保留在本地。
items.why_now: OpenCoworker 刚发布桌面版，支持本地部署且数据不上云，是隐私敏感场景的即刻切入点。
items.summary_en: **aisuite** is a lightweight Python library providing a unified, OpenAI-style Chat Completions API across 10+ LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Ollama, etc.), allowing provider swaps by changing a single string (e.g., `"openai:gpt-4o"`). Its **Agents API** layer adds tool calling via plain Python functions, multi-turn loops, built-in toolkits (files, git, shell), and MCP server support. The repo also ships **OpenCoworker**, a desktop AI agent (macOS/Windows) built on aisuite that performs deep research, file I/O, messaging (Slack/email), document generation, and scheduled automations—using your own API keys or local Ollama models, with data staying on-device.

items.title: “世航智能”完成A轮融资，融资金额超过10亿元
items.summary: 世航智能完成超10亿元A轮融资，创全球海洋机器人领域单轮融资规模纪录，投资方包括摩尔线程、昆仑芯产业基金上河动量基金、新加坡Vertex Growth、大洋电机及金沙江创投等。本轮融资将用于核心技术研发、全球化市场拓展及产业链生态建设，推动海洋机器人在复杂水下场景的规模化应用。
items.why_now: 世航智能刚完成超10亿元A轮融资，创全球海洋机器人领域单轮最大纪录。
items.summary_en: "世航智能," a marine embodied intelligence company, has completed a Series A funding round exceeding 1 billion yuan, marking the largest single-round financing in the global marine robotics sector. The round was led by investors including Shanghe Dongliang Fund (backed by chip firms Moore Threads and Kunlunxin), Singapore's Vertex Growth, and publicly listed大洋电机, with follow-on investments from existing shareholders like金沙江创投 (fifth round by founder朱啸虎),祥峰中国,华映资本, and长石资本. The funds will be used for core technology R&D, global market expansion, and ecosystem development to scale marine robots in complex underwater applications.

items.title: I indexed 669 GB of my GoPro videos using my M1 Max computer and local ML models
items.summary: 作者在M1 Max电脑上使用开源机器学习模型，对668.68 GB的628段GoPro骑行视频（总时长15小时13分18秒）进行本地索引，实现了对视频内容的自动搜索，并能将精彩片段直接导入DaVinci Resolve时间线进行剪辑。
items.why_now: 文章未提及时效性事件
items.summary_en: The author built a local ML pipeline on an M1 Max to index 2,207 GoPro cycling videos (669 GB, ~15 hours of footage) for search and automatic clip export to DaVinci Resolve. Using open-source models, he processed 628 videos locally to enable content-based search and streamlined editing workflow.

items.title: introducing gh-aw-fleet
items.summary: gh-aw-fleet 是一个用于 GitHub Agentic Workflows 的声明式舰队管理工具，通过一个 fleet.json 文件声明各仓库分配的工作流 profile，CLI 提供 deploy、sync、upgrade、add 等子命令且默认 dry-run，所有仓库操作通过 PR 完成，不直接 force-push。v0.2.0 已支持跨舰队漂移检测（gh-aw-fleet status，无需 clone）、JSON 结构化输出、可恢复部署、Layer-1 安全扫描，并为 2026-06-01 即将生效的 Copilot 按量计费预留了成本归集能力。该工具构建在 gh aw、gh、git 之上作为薄编排层，不重写工作流 markdown，核心回答"哪个仓库、何时、从哪个 profile 获取哪种工作流"这一问题。
items.why_now: 2026年6月1日起GitHub Copilot将按量计费，多仓库的Agentic Workflows急需统一成本追踪工具。
items.summary_en: I built gh-aw-fleet as a declarative CLI tool to centralize the management of GitHub Agentic Workflows (markdown-defined Claude/Copilot agents that compile to GitHub Actions). Using a single `fleet.json`, the tool reconciles repos across profiles (deploy, sync, upgrade) with a dry-run-first philosophy, meaning no operations touch a repository until `--apply` is explicitly added. Key current capabilities include fleet-wide status/drift detection, resumable deploys, a Layer-1 security scanner, and a consumption-tracking structure designed to meet GitHub's incoming June 1, 2026 Copilot usage-based billing requirements.

items.title: Least Privilege for AI Agents: One Identity, One Scope
items.summary: 一个AI客服代理因共享API密钥和邮箱、缺乏权限隔离，导致误操作波及整个平台，暴露了访问控制而非模型本身的问题。解决方案是采用最小权限原则：为每个代理分配独立身份、限定功能范围（如仅读邮件或仅创建草稿），并通过Nylas的Policies和Rules在系统层强制实施配额、发件限制和垃圾邮件检测（spam_sensitivity 0.1–5.0），而非依赖可被绕过的system prompt。关键操作包括使用独立grant隔离数据、按需启用MCP工具，并通过API策略（如每日发送上限、附件大小限制）和代理级规则（如出站域名拦截）实现硬性约束。
items.why_now: 多个AI Agent共享凭证导致安全事件频发，最小权限原则成紧迫需求。
items.summary_en: Nylas outlines a least-privilege framework for AI agents built on three principles: one identity, one scope, and one quota per agent. Instead of shared credentials or over-broad API keys, each agent gets its own Nylas API grant (isolated at the API level, free by design) with tool-surface scoping — e.g., a read-only summarizer is given only inbox access, no send tool — enforced at the tool layer rather than relying on system prompts alone. Policy and rule limits are then applied via the Agent Accounts API: policies bundle daily send quotas, attachment size/count caps, retention windows, and spam sensitivity (0.1–5.0 scale), while directional rules block outbound sends to unapproved domains with an immediate HTTP 403 before the email provider is ever reached.

items.title: When Regex Fails: My Journey to AI-Powered Data Extraction
items.summary: 针对网页爬取HTML中提取电话号码这一任务，作者测试了四种方案并对比效果：纯正则表达式仅能覆盖约70%的情况，且误报率高，无法处理"call me at 555-123-4567 after 5"等自然语言上下文；Beautiful Soup配合手工清理逻辑仍难以应对"tel:"链接和不可见字符等边界情况；spaCy NER模型在电话号码识别上效果零散，需额外训练自定义模型，成本过高。最终方案转向语义级提取：先用Beautiful Soup提取原始文本切块，再调用AI模型API（以extraction-v1为例）通过明确的自然语言提示词以JSON格式返回结构化结果，以温度值0.1保障输出一致性，完成去重与校验。该方法将提取逻辑从定义"模式"转变为描述"意图"，解决了语义歧义场景下的数据提取难题。
items.why_now: Regex等传统方式已无法满足复杂网页数据提取需求，AI语义解析正成为实时替代方案。
items.summary_en: The author abandoned regex and spaCy NER for extracting phone numbers from messy HTML, as regex produced false positives and spaCy's entity recognition was unreliable without custom training. They switched to a semantic extraction approach using an AI model API, sending text chunks with a prompt to return structured JSON containing phones, emails, and addresses. The method involves extracting raw text with Beautiful Soup, chunking it, calling the AI API with low temperature for consistency, then parsing and deduplicating the structured response.

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
items.summary: 由 NVIDIA 开发的 SkillSpector 是一款面向 AI Agent 技能的安全扫描工具，可在安装前检测漏洞、恶意模式和安全风险，支持扫描 Git 仓库、URL、zip 文件等多种输入格式，覆盖 16 类共 64 种漏洞模式（包括提示注入、数据泄露、权限提升等），并提供静态分析加可选 LLM 语义评估的两阶段分析流程。该工具支持终端、JSON、Markdown 和 SARIF 多种输出格式，提供 0–100 风险评分与严重性标签，还可通过 Docker 无需 Python 环境直接运行。研究显示，26.1% 的 AI Agent 技能存在漏洞，5.2% 具有潜在恶意意图，SkillSpector 正是为此类安全审查需求而设计。
items.why_now: NVIDIA 刚发布 SkillSpector 安全扫描器，应对 AI agent 技能 26.1% 含漏洞的紧迫风险。
items.summary_en: SkillSpector is an open-source security scanner by NVIDIA that detects vulnerabilities in AI agent skills (used by Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, etc.) before installation, addressing research showing 26.1% of skills contain vulnerabilities and 5.2% show likely malicious intent. It performs two-stage analysis—fast static analysis plus optional LLM semantic evaluation—across 64 vulnerability patterns in 16 categories (including prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, supply chain, and MCP tool poisoning), with live CVE lookups via OSV.dev and risk scoring on a 0–100 scale. The tool supports multi-format input (Git repos, URLs, zip files, directories, or single files), outputs in terminal, JSON, Markdown, and SARIF formats, and can be run via Python installation or Docker without requiring Python locally.

items.title: 乔木小说创作 Skill 开源发布
items.summary: 开源乔木小说创作 Skill，用户可通过安装命令 `npx skills add joeseesun/qiaomu-novel-generator` 一键集成，仅需说出“我想写一个小说”或指定风格，AI 即自动生成剧情梗概、人物设定、钩子、经典桥段、人物欲望、冲突升级及结尾等完整框架；经与 AI 讨论确认后，可生成完整且低“AI感”的小说内容。该项目已在 GitHub 开源。
items.why_now: 开源乔木小说创作Skill刚发布，助力AI辅助写小说。
items.summary_en: The "Qiaomu Novel Creation" open-source skill enables AI to generate full novel outlines—including plot summaries, character profiles, hooks, and conflict escalation—when triggered by prompts like "I want to write a novel" or specific style requests. It focuses on producing low-AI-detection ("low AI味") output through an iterative human-AI discussion workflow before finalizing the complete novel. Installation is done via `npx skills add joeseesun/qiaomu-novel-generator`.

items.title: Why AI hasn’t replaced software engineers, and won’t
items.summary: 尽管AI加速了编码过程，但2025年纽约州要求企业在WARN法案中披露AI使用情况，全年160多家公司提交通知，没有一家勾选"AI导致裁员"的选项。研究表明，软件工程的真正瓶颈并非写代码本身，而在于：（1）决定和明确要构建什么，（2）验证并承担责任，（3）对代码库、业务和环境有深入的人类理解——这三项核心任务当前的AI尚无法替代。
items.summary_en: Despite AI accelerating code-writing, mass software engineer layoffs haven't materialized—not one of 160+ companies in New York's first year of AI WARN Act disclosures checked the AI job-loss box. Surveys reveal the real bottlenecks in engineering are deciding what to build, verifying and being accountable for deliverables, and deep human understanding of the codebase and business context—tasks that resist automation even as AI assists with them.

items.title: Show HN: Morning Stack finds real job openings, tweaks resume and cover letter
items.summary: Morning Stack 是一款自动化求职工具，每晚在用户睡眠时运行，通过 Playwright 真实浏览器打开招聘网站验证职位真实性，并自动匹配用户简历与职位描述，为每个匹配职位定制简历和求职信，同时通过三重验证机制杜绝 AI 虚构内容，早上 7 点前为用户筛选出最多 3 个真实职位及完整申请材料。该工具不登录用户账户、不自动代投，强调用户自主提交以维护职业声誉。开发者妻子使用该工具在不到两周半内获得了一家大公司的录用通知，目前产品已开放小规模测试候补名单。
items.summary_en: Morning Stack is a tool that automates job hunting by running overnight to verify real job listings from major and niche boards using Playwright browser checks, cross-referencing them with user profiles via LLM, and tailoring resumes (with a 3-strike rule to prevent fabricated claims) to produce up to 3 vetted matches with cover letters by 7AM. Founded to streamline a painful job search process—leading to a job offer in under 2.5 weeks for the creator's wife—the tool prioritizes direct company applications without auto-applying or logging into accounts. Currently opening a small beta cohort with a waitlist, Morning Stack emphasizes user control over personal reputation while reducing spam and application overhead.

items.title: Show HN: V-COS – Governance layer that keeps AI coding agents coherent
items.summary: V-COS 是一个开源的 AI 编码代理治理层，旨在解决多代理协作时代码一致性与架构漂移问题。它通过定义可执行的架构规则（如模块边界、依赖约束、命名规范），在代理生成代码时实时校验并拦截违规操作，从而保持大型代码库的长期一致性。与依赖人工审查或事后静态分析不同，V-COS 将治理逻辑嵌入代理执行流程，实现“预防式”代码质量控制。
items.summary_en: V-COS is an open-source governance layer designed to keep AI coding agents coherent during long-running development sessions. It provides a structured framework that prevents agents from losing context and deviating from project goals across extended coding workflows. The project is hosted on GitHub at vagnerfirminopro/v-cos.

items.title: Show HN: Solaris the Thinking Ocean Simulator
items.summary: Solaris 是一个思维海洋模拟器，由 Franz-AI 开发。目前尚未提供具体的功能细节，但该项目已经在 Hacker News 发布，并获得少量关注。
items.summary_en: Solaris is a thinking ocean simulator that models fluid dynamics and cognitive processes in a unified environment, accessible at solaris.franzai.com. The project gained modest traction on Hacker News with 4 points and 2 comments, indicating early-stage community interest. No technical implementation details, revenue model, or specific capabilities were disclosed in the available content.

items.title: Show HN: RAIF – an experimental structured I/O format for LLMs
items.summary: RAIF 是一种专为大语言模型设计的实验性结构化输入输出格式，其标准草案已在 GitHub 上开源。该格式旨在通过定义清晰的数据结构提升 LLM 交互的可靠性与可扩展性，目前仍处于早期探索阶段，获得 1 个积分和 1 条评论。

items.title: Show HN: Kage – Shadow any website to a single binary for offline viewing
items.summary: Kage 是一款开源工具，可将任意网站完整镜像为单个可执行二进制文件，支持离线浏览，其源码已发布于 GitHub。该工具通过封装网页内容+轻量运行时实现部署，目前获得 Hacker News 社区 395 点及 90 条评论，反响积极。适合用于归档、演示或受限网络环境下的网页访问场景。
items.summary_en: Kage is a tool that snapshots any website into a single binary file for offline viewing, allowing entire sites to be preserved and opened without a network connection. The project gained traction on Hacker News with 395 points and 90 comments, highlighting interest in lightweight, portable web archiving. It targets developers and power users who need reliable offline access to documentation or reference sites.

items.title: Don't trust large context windows
items.summary: 这篇文章基于 Hacker News 社区对长文本上下文窗口能力的质疑展开讨论，指出尽管现代大语言模型（如 GPT、Claude）普遍支持数十万甚至百万级的 token 窗口，但在实际应用中，模型在长文本任务（如查找关键信息、保持逻辑一致性）上的表现仍显著退化。文章通过多个用户实测案例说明，即便输入在理论上下文范围内，超出约 10 万 token 后模型理解力和可靠性便急剧下滑。作者建议开发者应主动对长文本进行分段处理或借助外部检索机制（RAG），而非盲目依赖模型的“大窗口”参数。
items.summary_en: The article argues that despite marketing claims of 100K–200K+ token context window support, LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT-4) exhibit unreliable performance and hallucination at extreme effective lengths. The author demonstrates failures with "needle-in-a-haystack" and various multi-step comparison questions, showing severe performance drops at 20K–65K length even with Google Gemini 1.5 Pro, especially in long summaries. Effective useful context is much smaller than advertised.

items.title: Free SQL→ER diagram tool, runs in the browser, nothing uploaded
items.summary: 一个名为 sqltoerdiagram.com 的免费工具，可直接在浏览器中运行，将 SQL 文本即时转换为 ER 图，且完全不上传任何数据到服务器。该工具无需登录、无需安装，只需粘贴或编辑 SQL 代码即可自动生成实体关系图（ERD）。该工具服务器资源非常有限，可能需要限制用户访问，以确保稳定性。
items.summary_en: SqlToERDiagram.com converts SQL code into ER diagrams instantly in the browser, with all processing done client-side so no data is sent to servers. It supports multiple SQL dialects and remains completely free.

items.title: AWS Summit Los Angeles 2026: Why Am I Always Learning the Hard Way?
items.summary:
作者参加了 AWS Summit Los Angeles 2026 的 Kiro 实验课程，由 AWS 高级技术讲师 Clayton Markos 讲授，学习目标为**规范驱动开发（spec-driven development）**。

作者原本以 Claude 文档风格向 Kiro 提示，导致 AI 缺乏规范约束而产出偏差；实验中掌握了"先写规范（what 与边界），再由 Kiro 自主决定 how"的工作节奏，从而达成更高效的开发流程。

作者从自身自学经验出发，说明即使已有 steering-doc 等规范实践，若未与工具的 spec-driven 模式精准对齐，仍会重复付出"学习曲线税"，需要持续实践迭代才能找到"既不太死板也不太松散"的最优规范粒度。
items.summary_en: At the AWS Summit Los Angeles 2026, the Kiro spec-driven development lab reframed AI-assisted codegen projects, revealing that shipping with Kiro requires defining the "what" and constraints explicitly before touching a single line of code. The author learned that while Claude docs and notes served as great architecture and build assistants, they provided insufficient structure for Kiro, often leading to drift without clear boundaries. The session shifted the author's approach from treating Kiro like an autocomplete tool to leveraging it as a spec-writing partner that decides the "how" within defined constraints.

items.title: The Model Context Protocol (MCP): what it is and how to build a server
items.summary: MCP（Model Context Protocol）是一种由 Anthropic 创建、基于 MIT 协议开放的标准接口，旨在为 LLM 应用提供类似 USB-C 的统一连接方式，替代过去每个数据源都需要独立集成的碎片化方案。该协议基于 JSON-RPC 2.0，支持 stdio、SSE 和 Streamable HTTP 三种传输方式，并通过能力协商握手让客户端与服务器在会话开始前就确定支持的功能集。MCP 服务器对外暴露三类核心原语：Resources（供 LLM 读取上下文数据，类似 REST 的 GET 端点）、Tools（供 LLM 按需调用以执行代码或查询数据库，类似 POST 端点）和 Prompts（可复用的 LLM 交互模板）。截至 2026 年 5 月，Python SDK 版本为 1.27.2，规范已于 2025-11-25 发布稳定版，2026 年 6 月推出了包含更新传输层的 2.0.0 alpha 版本。
items.summary_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard (MIT-licensed, originally from Anthropic, spec version 2025-11-25) that provides a unified JSON-RPC 2.0 interface for LLM applications to connect to data sources, replacing bespoke integrations with a single protocol analogous to how LSP standardized editor-language communication. MCP servers expose three primitives—**Resources** (read-only data access via URIs), **Tools** (executable functions with JSON Schema inputs), and **Prompts** (reusable templates)—and communicate over three transports: stdio, SSE, or Streamable HTTP. The Python SDK (`mcp` on PyPI) is at v1.27.2 (May 2026), with a 2.0.0 alpha released in June 2026 featuring an updated transport layer.

items.title: kenn-io/agentsview
items.summary: AgentsView 是一款面向本地优先的编码 Agent（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）的会话智能与分析工具，支持超过 20 种主流 AI 编码代理，可作为 ccusage 的百倍性能替代品。它提供一个无需账户、完全本地的单二进制程序，帮助用户浏览、搜索并追踪所有 AI 编码代理的使用成本。首次启动时，AgentsView 自动发现本机所有兼容代理的会话并同步至本地 SQLite 数据库，随后在 127.0.0.1:8080 打开 Web UI，仅需执行 `agentsview serve` 即可启动服务，`agentsview usage daily` 可输出每日成本摘要。此外，该项目还提供 Docker 镜像及 PostgreSQL/DuckDB 支持的远程部署方案，并通过 `--public-url`、`--require-auth` 和安全 Host 验证机制保障跨网络环境下的访问安全与控制。
items.summary_en: agentsview is a local-first analytics tool for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and 20+ others, billed as a 100x faster alternative to ccusage for browsing, searching, and tracking costs across sessions. It indexes sessions into a local SQLite database and exposes a web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8080, with support for Docker deployment, optional PostgreSQL or DuckDB backends for remote or mirrored setups, and a security mode (--require-auth) for exposed instances. Installation is available via a single curl/powershell script, a desktop app (homebrew or GitHub Releases), or Docker image ghcr.io/kenn-io/agentsview:latest.

items.title: LMCache/LMCache
items.summary: LMCache 是一个专为 LLM 推理设计的 KV 缓存管理层，能将 KV 缓存转化为可持久化存储并跨服务引擎和请求重用的 AI 原生知识。其核心能力包括引擎独立的守护进程架构、分层存储卸载（支持 CPU、SSD、Redis、S3 等后端）、生产级可观测性以及通过 NIXL 等传输层支持 PD 分离和 KV 传输。截至 2026 年 5 月，LMCache 已在 AMD MI300X、NVIDIA Dynamo 等主流硬件和框架中集成，GitHub 星标超 5000，并显著降低了长上下文与多轮对话场景下的首词延迟（TTFT）并提升吞吐量。
items.summary_en: LMCache is a vendor-neutral, engine-independent KV cache management layer for LLM inference that stores KV cache persistently and enables reuse across serving engines, significantly reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) and improving throughput for long-context workloads. It supports tiered storage backends including CPU RAM, local disk, Redis/Valkey, S3-compatible storage, and NIXL, with non-prefix KV reuse via CacheBlend and PD disaggregation over NVLink, RDMA, or TCP. LMCache has achieved 5,000+ GitHub stars (August 2025), integrated with NVIDIA Dynamo, Redis, CoreWeave for Cohere, AMD MI300X, gpt-oss (20B/120B), and is now part of the PyTorch Foundation.

items.title: OpenAI 推出合作伙伴网络 OpenAI Partner Network
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布推出 OpenAI Partner Network，并投资 1.5 亿美元支持全球合作伙伴构建、销售和交付 AI 解决方案。该计划设立 Select、Advanced、Elite 三级合作伙伴层级，提供 Codex、网络安全、智能体等专业方向认证，并试点 Forward Deployed Experts 项目以支持复杂企业部署，目标在 2026 年底前培训认证 30 万名顾问。案例显示，Paychex 借助 Bain 和 OpenAI 的方案将等待时间降低 80%，人工审核时间减少 30%。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched the OpenAI Partner Network with a $150 million investment, featuring Select, Advanced, and Elite tiers with certifications in cybersecurity, agents, and Codex, plus a Forward Deployed Experts program for enterprise implementations, aiming to train 300,000 consultants by 2026. A case study shows Paychex reduced wait times by 80% and cut human review time by 30% using solutions from Bain and OpenAI.

items.title: HDC 2026 深度解构：鸿蒙全面向 Agent 架构演进，小艺做了这三件事
items.summary: HDC 2026 上，华为公开了小艺向 Agent 架构全面演进的三条路径：第一，系统应用全面 Skill 化，2100 多项系统能力和 200 多项系统数据接入小艺，手机与鸿蒙 PC 小艺之间通过 A2A 协议实现跨设备自主协同，任务拆解与多 Skill 调度对用户透明可见；第二，小艺开放平台提供 Agent、Skill、MCP 等多种接入方式，已有 500 伙伴 Skills 上线、2000 智能体上架，鸿蒙 AI 子系统日调用量 36.8 亿次；第三，小艺可通过对话调用「码上飞」等文生代码能力，让用户零代码生成个性化工具，从任务执行升级为工具创造。
items.summary_en: At HDC 2026, Huawei unveiled HarmonyOS's evolution to an Agent architecture with Xiaoyi as the system-level AI agent, integrating 2,100+ system Skills and 200+ system data sources through upgraded Harmony Agent Framework 2.0 (HMAF). The upgraded Xiaoyi Platform added 500+ partner Skills and 2,000+ Harmony agents with multiple access methods (Agent, Skill, MCP), processing 3.68 billion daily AI requests. Key capabilities included A2A protocol coordination, cross-device file sending (e.g., PC-to-phone without opening the laptop), and no-code tool generation via natural language — enabling intent-based service delivery ("What to eat" → automatic grocery ordering).

items.title: 36氪首发 | EBike变速器供应商打破海外巨头垄断，获国泰、达晨参与新一轮数千万元融资
items.summary: 洛梵狄智能科技完成数千万元B+轮融资，投资方包括国泰海通、达晨财智及广州黄埔科创母基金，资金主要用于研发、产能扩张和全球销售网络建设。该公司是中国第一家、全球第三家量产智能内变速器的厂商，其自研UHT超大扭矩专利将输入扭矩上限提升至200Nm，突破禧玛诺85Nm和enviolo HD 100Nm的物理限制，同时通过AI算法实现毫秒级自动换挡，续航提升30%。前年至去年业务增长5倍，去年至今年预计再增5倍，明年有望翻3倍，已有多个海外知名Ebike品牌实现量产合作。
items.summary_en: Luofandi Intelligent Technology has completed a new round of tens of millions of RMB in B+ financing, with investors including Guotai Haitong, Dacheng Caizhi, and Guangzhou Huangpu Science and Innovation Mother Fund. The company, the first in China and third globally to mass-produce smart internal transmissions, has developed the UHT ultra-high torque patent technology that raises input torque limits to 200Nm—double that of mainstream competitors like Shimano (85Nm) and Enviolo HD (100Nm). Its AI-powered electronic automatic transmission system enables millisecond-level gear shifts, improves range by 30%, and has entered mass production with multiple overseas Ebike brands, with revenue growing 5x year-over-year for two consecutive years.

items.title: 8点1氪丨诺奖得主称马斯克是庞氏骗局；SK海力士去年新增员工超2000人；人形机器人U1仅限成人购买
items.summary: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主保罗·克鲁格曼发文称马斯克为"庞氏骗局"，认为SpaceX的IPO建立在对马斯克个人崇拜而非商业价值评估之上，且约52%的共同基金资产投向指数基金，超50%美国家庭持有共同基金，普通投资者将被迫卷入这场资本游戏。特朗普政府禁止境外政府、企业及个人使用Anthropic旗下最先进AI模型，将尖端人工智能系统进一步视为国家安全核心资产。优必选人形机器人U1上线10天收获超3800台预售订单，定金总额逾千万元，该机器人分男女两款，搭载"养成系"情感大模型，配备88个高自由度运动关节，仅限成人购买。
items.summary_en:
Nobel laureate Paul Krugman labeled Elon Musk a "human Ponzi scheme," arguing SpaceX's IPO relies on retail investors' blind faith rather than sound valuation, with over 50% of U.S. households holding mutual funds now involuntarily exposed to Musk's ventures.

SK Hired 2,159 new employees in 2025, reaching 34,549 total, driven by surging AI-related memory chip demand, while Samsung's chip division saw a slight decline to 78,064.

Ubtech’s adult-only emotional companion humanoid robot U1 secured over 3,800 pre-orders in 10 days, generating over ¥10 million in deposits; it features 88 high-degree-of-freedom joints, an "emotional growth" AI model, and lacks 3C certification. The U.S. also restricted foreign access to Anthropic’s most advanced AI models, citing national security.

items.title: “大晓机器人”完成天使+轮融资
items.summary: "大晓机器人"于近日完成天使+轮融资，吸引了吉利资本、达晨财智、深创投、战略股东商汤国香资本（持续增资）等超过十家知名投资方支持，并聘有告捷资本担任长期财务顾问；加上此前的融资轮次，其2026年上半年已累计获得数亿美元资金。融资完成后，大晓机器人将重点利用资金推进其具身智能通用操作系统的研发、跨行业批量落地能力的建设和国际化布局。本轮所获资金将有助于加速其在具身智能这一热门赛道的商业化落地的步伐。
items.summary_en: Daxiao Robot has completed its Angel+ funding round, attracting investors including Geely Capital, Fortune China, Shenzhen Capital Group, Shanghai Science and Technology Innovation Fund, MetaX, Shengyu Investment, Fuxin Ruizheng, Huakong Fund, Lingang New Area Fund, and Yuzi Zhangquan, with existing shareholder SenseTime Guoxiang Capital increasing its stake. The company has raised a total of several hundred million USD in the first half of 2026, with Gaocapital serving as long-term financial advisor.

items.title: don't spend tons of money and time, test NOW
items.summary: 多年创业经验表明，花6个月以上开发产品再验证市场需求往往代价高昂且低效。现在更推荐的做法是：先创建简单落地页说明产品，投放少量付费流量，通过早期访问列表或候补名单测试真实兴趣。这样做能让强信号项目快速投入市场，也能及时止损那些自认可行但无人问津的创意，避免浪费数月开发时间。
items.summary_en: Validate product demand before investing significant time and money: launch a simple landing page, pay for a small amount of traffic, and if interest is strong, collect a waitlist or early-access requests. This approach signals genuine demand early, validating high-potential ideas and saving 6+ months of building unwanted products. The key metric is genuine interest from paid traffic, not product completeness, enabling fast iteration or pivoting before full development.

items.title: Auditing What Your Email Agent Actually Did
items.summary: Nylas 的 Agent Account（目前处于 Beta 阶段）提供了一个托管邮箱，其 Sent 文件夹中存储了邮件 Agent 发出的所有真实消息对象，可通过 Messages API 获取，且无法伪造发件人身份。通过一次 API 调用即可查询 Agent 过去发送的消息，并结合邮件头（Message-ID、In-Reply-To、References）重建完整的对话上下文，从而区分"Agent 发送了14条消息"与"因对方反复提问而发送14条消息"。此外，系统通过 Webhook 实时推送 message.send_success、message.send_failed 和 message.bounce_detected 等发送结果事件，同时记录策略规则的评估日志，使运维人员无需依赖 Agent 自身日志即可获得服务端完整的审计追踪。
items.summary_en: Nylas Agent Accounts provide built-in email auditability by storing every outbound message as a real, timestamped object in the Sent folder — accessible via the same Messages API (`GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages?in=sent`) — with no side door for unsent or spoofed messages since sends are stamped with the grant's own address. Full conversation context is reconstructable via thread API calls using standard Message-ID/In-Reply-To/References headers, and send outcomes (success, failure, bounce) arrive as server-side webhooks independent of agent logging. Rule evaluations are also queryable per grant (`GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/rule-evaluations`), enabling a complete incident review from sent-folder listing through thread reconstruction to deliverability outcome.

items.title: Building Loom (Part 3): Real-Time Browser UI with SSE, Goroutines, and Channels
items.summary: Loom 是一个 gRPC 调试代理，通过 Server Reflection 实时解码 gRPC 流量（无需 .proto 文件），并使用 SSE（Server-Sent Events）将数据推送到浏览器 UI。核心采用 Go 的 Hub 模式和 goroutines/channels，实现单个请求向浏览器、日志和录制器三路并行广播，100 个并发请求下总延迟仅约 6ms。前端为单一 40KB 的 HTML 文件，使用原生 EventSource API 无构建依赖，页面无需刷新即可实时展示每个 gRPC 调用的 JSON 载荷、状态码和耗时。
items.summary_en: Loom is a gRPC debugging proxy that sits transparently between clients and backends, auto-decoding all four unary and streaming call types via Server Reflection — no .proto files required — and streaming results in real time to a browser UI at `localhost:9998`. The core architecture uses a Go "hub" pattern with goroutines and channels: a single `Hub` goroutine owns all SSE client connections via `register/unregister/broadcast` channels, and each incoming gRPC request is fanned out concurrently to the SSE hub, a logger, and a recorder in separate goroutines, achieving ~6ms total overhead at 100 concurrent requests. The frontend is a single 40KB vanilla JS HTML file using the native `EventSource` SSE API — no React, no build step — while SSE was chosen over WebSockets because server→browser one-directional streaming is simpler, auto-reconnects natively, and needs no bidirectional protocol.

items.title: chatwoot/chatwoot
items.summary: Chatwoot 是一款开源自托管的客户支持平台，可替代 Intercom、Zendesk 等服务商方案，提供全渠道收件箱收件（支持网站在线聊天、邮件、WhatsApp、Telegram、社交媒体等多渠道），并集成了名为 Captain 的 AI 智能客服代理用于自动应答常见问题。平台内置知识库门户、工单自动化、团队协作工具（如 @提及、快捷回复、自动分配）、Slack/Shopify/Dialogflow 等第三方集成，以及实时会话监控、客服绩效报告和 CSAT 报告等分析功能。支持一键部署至 Heroku 和 DigitalOcean Kubernetes，并提供完整的本地化翻译流程和 git-flow 版本管理。
items.summary_en: Chatwoot is an open-source, self-hosted customer support platform that serves as an alternative to tools like Intercom, Zendesk, and Salesforce Service Cloud. Its key features include Captain (an AI agent for automating responses and handling common queries), an omnichannel inbox (supporting live chat, email, social media, and messaging apps), a help center portal, and tools for collaboration, automation, and customer segmentation. The platform offers integrations with services such as Slack, Dialogflow, Shopify, and Linear, and supports deployment via Heroku or DigitalOcean.

items.title: Stripe Projects Opens Cloud Infrastructure Buying To AI Agents via @sejournal, @slobodanmanic
items.summary: Stripe 推出 Stripe Projects，为 AI Agent 提供结构化目录、程序化注册端点和委托结算接口，实现自动化云基础设施采购。
items.summary_en: Stripe Projects enables AI agents to purchase cloud infrastructure using Stripe's new API, featuring a structured product catalog, programmatic signup endpoint, and delegated billing controls. This allows companies to sell infrastructure like compute, storage, and data transfer to autonomous AI systems. The launch positions Stripe as a potential standard for AIM, the Agentic Internet Money protocol.

items.title: x1xhlol/system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools
items.summary: 由 x1xhlol/system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools 维护的开源项目收集并公开了包括 Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI、Lovable、Nexus、Perplexity、Replit、Windsurf、Xcode、v0 在内的大量主流 AI 开发工具的完整系统提示词、内部工具配置及模型信息，并定期更新（最新更新为 2026 年 10 月 5 日）。该项目同时提供针对 AI 初创企业的安全警示，警告暴露的系统提示词易遭黑客攻击，并推荐 ZeroLeaks 服务以防范提示词注入和系统提示词提取风险，开发者可通过 GitHub Issue 提交反馈或新增内容。项目通过 Patreon、Ko-fi 和加密货币渠道接受社区支持。
items.summary_en: This collection, titled "x1xhlol/system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools," compiles system prompts, internal tools, and AI models from prominent platforms such as Cursor, Devin, Claude Code, Replit, and Perplexity. Maintained by Lucas Valbuena (Lucknite), it serves as a comprehensive Open Source repository for developers to study how these leading AI coding tools operate. The project accepts support via Patreon, crypto, and Ko-fi, and emphasizes security risks like prompt injection.

items.title: music-assistant/server
items.summary: Music Assistant 是一款免费的开源媒体库管理器，可连接多种流媒体服务和音响设备，其核心服务需运行在树莓派、NAS 或 Intel NUC 等常在线设备上。虽然主要代码基于 Python，但由于依赖 ffmpeg 等外部组件，只能通过 Docker 容器或 Home Assistant 插件方式安装，无法作为独立 PyPI 包运行。推荐将其与 Home Assistant 配合使用，以充分发挥自动化能力。
items.summary_en: Music Assistant is a free, open-source media library manager that connects to streaming services and connected speakers, with its server core requiring always-on hardware like a Raspberry Pi, NAS, or Intel NUC. While primarily coded in Python, it relies on external dependencies including ffmpeg, so it can only be deployed via Docker or as a Home Assistant add-on, not as a standalone PyPI package. It is designed for automation and operates alongside Home Assistant, with documentation available at music-assistant.io.

items.title: apple/container
items.summary: container 是 Apple 在 macOS 26 上推出的一个用 Swift 编写的开源工具，专为 Apple silicon 优化，用于在 Mac 上通过轻量级虚拟机创建和运行 Linux 容器。它兼容 OCI 标准镜像格式，可从任意标准容器仓库拉取和推送镜像，并通过系统命令 `container system start` 启动服务。目前已支持升级到最新版本（如 v0.3.0），采用 patch 版本内稳定的策略，1.0.0 之前的 minor 版本可能包含破坏性变更。
items.summary_en: container is a Swift-based tool for running Linux containers as lightweight VMs on Apple silicon Macs, requiring macOS 26+ for virtualization and networking features. It supports OCI-compatible container images, enabling integration with standard registries. The tool is installed via signed packages, provides upgrade/downgrade scripts, and its API stability is only guaranteed across patch versions (e.g., 0.1.x).

directions.name: BranchDB
directions.description: 为每个 Git 分支自动创建隔离的本地数据库实例，解决多分支并行开发时的 schema 冲突问题
directions.target_user: 使用 Git worktree 进行并行开发的独立开发者和小型团队
core_features: 自动检测 Git worktree 并创建独立数据库实例
一键切换分支时自动迁移和同步 schema
可视化界面显示各分支数据库状态和 migration 历史
directions.why_now: Hacker News 上 Wtdb 项目获得 8/10 评分，社区讨论显示 agentic coding 场景下多分支并发操作数据库时的 schema 竞争问题日益突出，开发者迫切需要自动化解决方案
directions.monetization: 基础功能免费，高级功能（如团队协作、云同步）采用订阅制
directions.source_article: Show HN: Wtdb – give every Git worktree its own database

directions.name: FleetOps
directions.description: 声明式 GitHub Agentic Workflows 舰队管理工具，通过单一配置文件管理多仓库工作流部署
directions.target_user: 管理多个 GitHub 仓库的 DevOps 工程师和一人公司创业者
core_features: fleet.json 声明式配置各仓库工作流 profile
CLI 提供 deploy/sync/upgrade 等子命令，默认 dry-run
跨舰队漂移检测和 JSON 结构化输出
directions.why_now: DEV Community 上 gh-aw-fleet 项目获得 7/10 评分，跨源热点显示开源工具类别有 4 个源报道，且 2026-06-01 Copilot 按量计费即将生效，成本归集需求迫切
directions.monetization: 开源核心功能，提供企业版支持私有部署和高级安全扫描
